references.text: The children of Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight - same expression and theme regarding Israel's repeated sin
The children of Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight - part of the recurring pattern in Judges
The children of Israel continued to do what was evil in the Lord's sight - same cycle of sin
The children of Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight - repetition of the same formula
The children of Israel again did what was evil in the Lord's sight - same pattern of apostasy
The king of Moab is mentioned in connection with Israel's history - Balak and Moab's relationship with Israel
The Lord will raise up enemies against Israel as punishment for disobedience - God's judgment through foreign nations
The Lord raised up adversaries against Solomon - same principle of God strengthening enemies as punishment
God uses foreign nations as instruments of His judgment upon His people
